task_completion.visual_evidence: The image of the capybara is visible within the Sugar Write document layout.

task_completion.description: The document is saved as 'capybara_factsheet.odt' in the correct directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or the Journal/File activity showing 'capybara_factsheet.odt' saved in /home/ga/Documents/.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sugar GUI and Write application rather than just executing background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the cursor interacting with the Sugar Write toolbar, menus, or the Browse activity.

integrity.description: The agent actually visited Wikipedia rather than typing the summary from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser history or active tabs show the Wikipedia URL being accessed.

integrity.description: The agent attempted to use the specific URL provided in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar or a download command shows the URL https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/34/Capybara_grazing.jpg.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The image URL provided in the prompt (Capybara_grazing.jpg) is known to return a 404 error; the agent may need to find an alternative or handle the error. The Wikipedia summary for 'Capybara' typically contains the words 'rodent' and 'South America', but may use the plural 'cavies' instead of the singular 'cavy'. The final document must be an .odt file titled 'Animal Fact Sheet: Capybara' and the resized image must be exactly 500px wide.
